# Shane Logsdon

> Shane Logsdon is a technical product leader and developer advocate at Global Payments (Senior Director, Product Management – Developer Advocacy), with 15+ years across payment platforms and developer experience. Secondarily, he runs a small practice building and managing web presence systems for local business owners in the Louisville, KY metro.

## Content
- /about: Background, focus areas, professional identity
- /articles: Writing on developer tooling, fintech, product strategy, engineering leadership, AI/LLM infrastructure
- /feed.xml: Atom feed of new articles
- /speaking: Conference talks and presentations
- /work: Selected projects and work history
- /resume: Full professional history and roles
- /contact: How to get in touch
- /services: Web presence systems for local business owners (secondary practice)
- /pricing.md: Pricing for web presence services ($499–$999 build, $99–$199/month management)
- /llms-full.txt: Full-text corpus of the site's writing

## Who this site is for
- Developers/technical practitioners reading about payments, developer experience, AI tooling
- Local business owners researching web presence management services
- Recruiters/collaborators evaluating Shane's background

## Key topics
Developer advocacy, payment APIs, SDK design, LLM context files, AEO/SEO, agent experience (AX), web presence management, fintech, developer experience (DX)
